lines.en: label saraspring7:
scene noonsky
Now that I’ve managed to seamlessly weave Yuki Yamaguchi’s sad existence back into my mutually sad life, I figure it only makes sense to go after her daughter next.
lines.zh: 既然我已经把 Yuki Yamaguchi 悲惨的存在完美地织回我同样悲惨的人生里，我想下一步去找她女儿也算顺理成章。

lines.en: And by...{i}go after{/i} I mean track her down. Unless that sounds even more predatory. To which I’d just say imagine I’m out here to find Yumi and teach her about math or something because she probably needs it.
lines.zh: 而我说的{i}「去找」{/i}，是指把人找出来。除非那听起来更像捕食——那我只能说，就当我是出来找 Yumi，教她点数学什么的吧，因为她大概确实需要。

lines.en: But I guess this probably won’t be the place to find her anymore on account of the whole “having a job” thing and that I’m likely just going to run into Io instead.
lines.zh: 不过我猜这儿大概已经不是能找到她的地方了，毕竟她「有了份工作」，而且我很可能只会撞见 Io 而已。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk1
Or apparently Sara, who isn’t even in the same age group as the last two girls I mentioned, but is still very cute regardless.
lines.zh: 或者显然该说是 Sara——她跟我刚才提到的那两个女孩压根不是一个年龄段的，但不管怎么说还是很可爱。

lines.en: : You’re not Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你不是 Yumi。

lines.en: : No, but sometimes I wish I was because it would make Yuki like me more. What are you doing over here?
lines.zh: : 不是，不过有时候我希望我是，因为那样 Yuki 会喜欢我多一点。你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk2
: In fact, what are you doing in public to begin with? I’ve seen TikToks about you. You know it’s not safe out here now that you’re dating a celebrity, right?
lines.zh: : 说起来，你一开始怎么会跑到公共场合来？我在 TikTok 上刷到过你。你知道现在你跟一个名人谈恋爱，在外面不安全吧？

lines.en: : I was perfectly fine when I went to the bar the other night.
lines.zh: : 我前两天晚上去酒吧的时候明明好好的。

lines.en: : Sure, but you had Yuki to protect you back then. And if you’re hoping {i}I’m{/i} going to be able to protect you this time, I have very bad news.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那时候有 Yuki 保护你。而如果你指望这次{i}我{/i}能保护你，那我有个非常坏的消息。

lines.en: : Plus, the bar is a controlled environment. And if you-
lines.zh: : 再说，酒吧是个可控的环境。而且如果你——

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk3
: Wait! What if {i}I{/i} made a video advertising the bar while you were inside? People might flock to the store thinking they could take pictures of you or something!
lines.zh: : 等等！要是你在里面的时候，{i}我{/i}拍个视频给酒吧打广告呢？人们说不定会蜂拥进店，想着能给你拍几张照什么的！

lines.en: : Please don’t leverage my childhood friend’s fame to boost sales. I think that’s immoral, I just can’t explain why.
lines.zh: : 请别拿我青梅竹马的名气来促销。我觉得这事不道德，只是我解释不清为什么。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk4
: {i}Fine.{/i} But only because I like knowing a side of you the paparazzi don’t. And probably shouldn’t because you are not exactly the most morally good man I’ve never known.
lines.zh: : {i}好吧{/i}。不过只是因为我喜欢知道一个狗仔不知道的你。而且他们大概也不该知道——毕竟你算不上什么道德高尚的男人，虽然我其实并不认识你。

lines.en: : Better me than a teenager, though.
lines.zh: : 不过总比是个青少年强。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk5
: Unless the paparazzi think I {i}am{/i} a teenager and we’re in the midst of developing a scandal...Oh no. How horrible would that be?
lines.zh: : 除非狗仔以为我{i}是{/i}个青少年，而我们正处在丑闻发酵的当口……哦不。那得多可怕啊？

lines.en: : Just get off the Internet entirely and stop thinking about any of that stuff. That’s how I’ve been coping with it.
lines.zh: : 干脆彻底断网，别再想那些事了。我就是这么扛过来的。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk6
: Is it really coping if that’s how you’ve always been, though?
lines.zh: : 可如果你一直是这样，那还算「扛」吗？

lines.en: : Who says I haven’t been coping my entire life?
lines.zh: : 谁说我不是一辈子都在扛？

lines.en: : Fair point. But if I didn’t use the Internet, I wouldn’t have seen all of those cute childhood pictures of you and Niki and start secretly cheering for you guys while my jealousy meter skyrockets behind the scenes.
lines.zh: : 有道理。可如果我不上网，就不会看到你和 Niki 那些可爱的童年照，也不会一边偷偷给你们加油，一边在背后让我的嫉妒值爆表了。

lines.en: : You make it sound like there’s been more than just the one.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像照片不止那一张似的。

lines.en: : Oh, you haven’t heard? She posted a bunch more when her agency tried to brush it under the rug. They’re all over the place now.
lines.zh: : 哦，你没听说吗？她经纪公司想把这事压下去的时候，她又发了一堆。现在满世界都是。

lines.en: : What? When? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？什么时候？为什么？

lines.en: : Why don’t you just ask her?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不直接去问她？

lines.en: : Because she’s scary and mad at me for extremely reasonable...reasons. And I’ve decided it’s best to just let her do whatever she wants without getting in her way for now.
lines.zh: : 因为她很吓人，而且因为非常合理……的理由在生我的气。而我决定眼下最好就是随她做什么都行，别挡她的路。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for that. Because I now have a bunch of pictures saved of little Akira and I love him. It makes me wish I had a childhood friend to fall in love with back then instead of a manipulative adult.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就多谢了。因为我现在存了一堆小 Akira 的照片，我太喜欢他了。这让我希望自己当年也有个青梅竹马可以坠入爱河，而不是一个别有用心的成年人。

lines.en: : Just be glad you didn’t have both because it would lay the groundwork for ruining the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 你就庆幸你没有两者兼有吧，因为那会为你毁掉余生打下基础。

lines.en: : I think if anything, this ruins Niki’s more than yours.
lines.zh: : 我觉得要说毁，这毁的也是 Niki 的人生，比你的多。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sara. That is exactly what I wanted to hear right now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sara。这正是我现在最想听到的。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk7
: That...came out way worse than I meant for it to come out! I’m sorry! I...actually think it’s {i}adorable{/i} how she threw her career away for you! It means she really loves you and-
lines.zh: : 那……话说得比我想表达的难听多了！对不起！我……其实觉得她为你放弃事业这一点特别{i}可爱{/i}！这说明她真的很爱你，而且——

lines.en: : I get it. And it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我懂。没关系。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk8
: It’s just...all she’s ever done is throw things away for me. So it only makes sense that that’s how she’d try and go out in the end.
lines.zh: : 只是……她为我做的，就只有不断丢弃东西。所以她最后选择以这种方式退场，也就说得通了。

lines.en: : Mnh...I feel like the more I talk about this, the worse I’m making everything. And it’s becoming increasingly difficult to figure out how to get you to invite her to the bar so I can fangirl over her.
lines.zh: : 嗯唔……我觉得这事我越说越糟。而且我越来越不知道该怎么让你把她请到酒吧来，好让我追个星。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot you were a fan.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了你是她的粉丝。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk9
: That’s why I went out shopping, actually. I wanted to see if I could get a CD or something before they were all pulled from the shelves, but it seems like everywhere’s already been cleared out.
lines.zh: : 其实我今天出来逛街就是因为这个。我想在下架前看看能不能买到一张 CD 什么的，可好像哪儿都已经清空了。

lines.en: : I even asked the music shop at the mall and they said the entire stock was bought out by one girl. Idol fans can be really terrifying sometimes, huh?
lines.zh: : 连商场里的音像店我都问了，他们说整批货被一个女孩买光了。偶像粉丝有时候真的挺吓人的，对吧？

lines.en: : I get all that. What I don’t get is how you wound up with a leek in the bag.
lines.zh: : 这些我都懂。我不懂的是，你袋子里怎么会有一根大葱。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk10
: I didn’t want to go home empty-handed and it was on sale.
lines.zh: : 我不想空手回家，而且它在打折。

lines.en: : Would you like me to get you a Niki CD, Sara?
lines.zh: : 要我给你弄张 Niki 的 CD 吗，Sara？

lines.en: : It’s fine. Just let me borrow {i}her{/i} for a little while instead. That much should be fine after all the free drinks I’ve given you, right?
lines.zh: : 不用了。让我借用{i}她{/i}一小会儿就行。我给了你那么多免费酒，这点要求总不过分吧？

lines.en: : I guess. I’m just surprised that you waited so long to make me settle my tab like this when you’ve known I’ve been dating her for years now.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我只是奇怪，你明明知道我跟她在一起好几年了，怎么拖这么久才用这招让我结账。

lines.en: : I’ve been holding this in for a long time. But if Niki’s going to crash out, I think it’s only fair that I get to crash out too.
lines.zh: : 我憋了很久了。不过既然 Niki 要崩，那我觉得我也该崩一次，才算公平。

lines.en: : Lunch?
lines.zh: : 午饭？

lines.en: : I was wondering when you were going to ask.
lines.zh: : 我还在想你什么时候才开口呢。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk11
We walk past where the sidewalk ends and begin to make our way to a local diner. And, as has become customary as of late, there’s no shortage of people taking pictures.
lines.zh: 我们走过人行道尽头，朝一家本地小餐馆走去。而就像最近已成惯例的那样，拍照的人一点都不少。

lines.en: Gossiping.
lines.zh: 说闲话的。

lines.en: Asking who {i}this{/i} girl is and why I’m not with Niki. Calling me names. Calling {i}Sara{/i} names. And it’s just something I’m going to have to live with now.
lines.zh: 问{i}这{/i}女孩是谁、我为什么没跟 Niki 在一起。骂我。骂 {i}Sara{/i}。而这些，我现在都得承受着过日子。

lines.en: I’m emotionally detached enough to not really register this is a {i}problem{/i} or something to be offended by...but I can’t help but worry about how Sara is going to interpret all of it.
lines.zh: 我在情感上已经足够抽离，压根不会把这当成{i}问题{/i}、或者觉得受到了冒犯……可我还是忍不住担心 Sara 会怎么理解这一切。

lines.en: I just don’t want our entire relationship needing to occur within the walls of her own home now. But if being out in public with her is going to subject to her to {i}this{/i} then...
lines.zh: 我只是不想让我们整段关系只能发生在她自己家里的四壁之内。可要是和她一起出门就得让她承受{i}这些{/i}，那……

lines.en: I guess it might have to.
lines.zh: 我想也许也只能这样了。

lines.en: I guess this is just how things are now.
lines.zh: 我想，事情现在就是这样了。

lines.en: : Sorry about all of the...everything.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，关于……这一切。

lines.en: : How did you guess the title of my autobiography?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么猜到我自传的标题的？

lines.en: : What do you need to apologize for? You’re only getting insulted because you’re out and about with me.
lines.zh: : 你有什么好道歉的？你被骂，只是因为你跟我一起出门。

lines.en: : Oh, that doesn’t bother me at all. I was called way worse in high school once word got around that I was sleeping with a teacher. And that’s not even counting all my parents said to me on a daily basis.
lines.zh: : 哦，那点事我一点都不在乎。高中时候「跟老师睡觉」的传言一传开，我被骂得比这难听多了。这还没算上我父母每天对我说的话。

lines.en: : Sure, but none of that’s anything you should apologize for.
lines.zh: : 是，可那些都不是你该道歉的事。

lines.en: : Maybe not to you. But I brought children into this world. And now Sana has to live with the fact that her mother was, once upon a time, a foolish and lovesick moron. My background alone taints her existence.
lines.zh: : 也许对你不用。可我把孩子带到了这个世上。而如今 Sana 必须承受这样一个事实：她母亲曾经是个愚蠢又为爱昏头的白痴。光是我的出身，就玷污了她的存在。

lines.en: : I don’t think Sana would agree with that, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不觉得 Sana 会同意这点。

lines.en: : No, neither do I. But I do think she won’t ever look at me the same way other girls look at {i}their{/i} moms.
lines.zh: : 不，我也不觉得。但我确实觉得，她永远不会像别的女孩看{i}自己{/i}妈妈那样看我。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’s glad she has a mom to look at in general when half of her classmates just {i}don’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她一半的同学连个妈妈都{i}没有{/i}，我敢说她总的来说还是庆幸自己有个妈可以看的。

lines.en: : I hope you’re right about that. It still kills me that Ayane’s mom walked out on her. She’d probably think twice if she could see her now.
lines.zh: : 希望你说得对。Ayane 的妈妈抛弃她这件事，到现在还让我难受。要是她现在能看到女儿，大概会三思吧。

lines.en: : Is it Ayane appreciation time? I can get behind that.
lines.zh: : 现在是 Ayane 夸夸时间吗？这个我支持。

lines.en: : How’s she taking all of this? The Niki stuff, I mean.
lines.zh: : 她怎么样？我是说 Niki 那件事。

lines.en: : Because you two have always been really close, and I can’t imagine it’s good. But she seemed to just shrug it off when I saw her the other night, and that confused me.
lines.zh: : 因为你俩一直很亲近，我想她肯定不好受。可我前两天晚上见到她时，她好像只是耸耸肩就过去了，这让我有点摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : Ayane has bigger issues to worry about right now. And she’s also known about Niki for a long time, so I imagine this is just more of the same for her.
lines.zh: : Ayane 现在有更大的问题要操心。而且她知道 Niki 的事已经很久了，所以我想这对她来说只是老样子。

lines.en: : You {i}imagine?{/i} So you guys haven’t talked about it yet?
lines.zh: : {i}你想{/i}？那你们还没谈过？

lines.en: : We’re...having a hard time talking at all lately. Things feel...weird. And neither one of us can figure out why.
lines.zh: : 我们……最近连话都说不太好。感觉……怪怪的。而我们都搞不清为什么。

lines.en: : Weird how?
lines.zh: : 怎么个怪法？

lines.en: : It’s like a...{i}nauseous{/i} feeling we’re getting, almost. That same sort of feeling you get when you can’t remember if you left the stove on.
lines.zh: : 就像一种……{i}恶心{/i}的感觉，差不多。就是那种你不记得自己有没有关炉子时的感觉。

lines.en: : I’ve been feeling that since I went out this morning.
lines.zh: : 我从今天早上出门起就一直有这种感觉。

lines.en: : Do you want to stop at the bar first then?
lines.zh: : 那要不要先去酒吧停一下？

lines.en: : No. This is the closest I’ve ever been to feeling like a celebrity and I don’t want it to end yet.
lines.zh: : 不。这是我这辈子最接近名人感觉的一次，我还不想让它结束。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk12
: I really think you two {i}should{/i} talk about it, though. Maybe put on your dad-pants and sit her down on something that isn’t your lap for once.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的觉得你们俩{i}该{/i}谈谈。也许穿上你的「爸爸裤」，让她坐到什么上面——这次别是你的大腿。

lines.en: : I’d love to. But Ayane’s never been as open with me as I’d like her to be. If anything, I think Sana would have a better shot at getting through to her right now than I would.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊。可 Ayane 从来不像我希望的那样对我敞开心扉。要说有谁，我觉得现在 Sana 比我更有可能说服她。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk13
: I can see why you’d feel that way, but Sana’s not exactly the best when it comes to discussing...serious issues either.
lines.zh: : 我能理解你为什么这么想，可 Sana 在讨论……严肃问题上也不是什么高手。

lines.en: : I agree. She and Ayane are still like sisters at the end of the day, though.
lines.zh: : 我同意。不过说到底，她和 Ayane 还是像姐妹一样。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk14
: Sisters, huh?...
: Oh, shit. Should I not have-
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。我是不是不该——

lines.en: : No, you’re fine...I’m...
lines.zh: : 不，你没事……我……

lines.en: : I’m glad she has someone like that again. And I’m glad it’s Ayane. She’s a good influence.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴她又有了那样一个人。而我很高兴那个人是 Ayane。她对她是个好影响。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I worry that the years she spent {i}without{/i} a...sibling...might have turned her into something I just can’t really...{i}parent{/i} the way I want to, you know?
lines.zh: : 我担心，她{i}没有{/i}……兄弟姐妹……的那些年，可能把她变成了某种我没法……按我想要的方式去{i}教养{/i}的人，你懂吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...both of our kids lost someone extremely important to them. And both are permanently damaged because of it. But hey, at least Sana isn’t threatening to kill everyone you love.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们俩的孩子都失去了对他们极其重要的人。也都因此留下了永久的创伤。不过话说回来，至少 Sana 没在威胁要杀掉你爱的所有人。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk15
: Is Ami really doing that? But she’s such a sweetheart. I can’t imagine that at all.
lines.zh: : Ami 真的在这么做吗？可她那么甜。我完全想象不出来。

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, I actually think you might be spared all the potential bloodshed. Ami’s always really liked you for some reason.
lines.zh: : 说来也怪，我觉得你大概会幸免于那场潜在的流血事件。Ami 不知为什么一直很喜欢你。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk16
: Do I remind her of her mom, maybe? I’ve always been afraid to really {i}talk{/i} about that with her since I just don’t know enough about their relationship and...what happened.
lines.zh: : 也许我让她想起了她妈妈？我一直不敢跟她深{i}聊{/i}那件事，因为我对她们的关系、还有……发生过的事知道得太少。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s it. But even...{i}I{/i} don’t know much about Ami’s relationship with her mom since my presence in her life sort of...tapered off after Ami was born.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是那个原因。不过连{i}我{/i}……也不太了解 Ami 和她妈妈的关系，因为 Ami 出生后，我在她生命里的存在就渐渐……淡了。

lines.en: : You have the same amount of love to give, though. Almost {i}too{/i} much. And it’s that...{i}unwavering{/i} sort of love that I just...
lines.zh: : 可你拥有的爱一点都不少。甚至多{i}过头{/i}了。而正是那种……{i}毫不动摇{/i}的爱，让我……

lines.en: : I don’t know. This isn’t really the place to-
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这儿真的不是——

lines.en: : Akira, are you trying to tell me your love for Ami is {i}wavering?{/i}
lines.zh: : Akira，你是想说，你对 Ami 的爱{i}动摇{/i}了吗？

lines.en: : That’s...I don’t know. It feels that way sometimes...
lines.zh: : 那个……我不知道。有时候感觉就是那样……

lines.en: : She’s just...she’s difficult in a way I don’t know how to handle. And I thought having Niki around would change that, but-
lines.zh: : 她只是……她难搞的方式让我不知道该怎么处理。我原以为有 Niki 在会改变这一点，可——

lines.en: : Having a woman around the house won’t do anything to change {i}your{/i} feelings for {i}your{/i} daughter.
lines.zh: : 家里有个女人，改变不了{i}你{/i}对{i}你{/i}女儿的感情。

lines.en: : I get that she’s difficult and that it might be scary figuring out how to confront her when you need to, but surely that doesn’t change how you feel as a whole, right? I’ve seen how much you love her firsthand.
lines.zh: : 我知道她难搞，也知道在需要面对她时会害怕，可那总不至于改变你整体的感受吧？我可是亲眼见过你有多爱她。

lines.en: : Hell, we even went {i}camping{/i} to prove it. There’s no way in hell I’d be able to drag you out to go camping under normal circumstances.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，我们甚至去{i}露营{/i}来证明这一点。正常情况下，我绝不可能把你拖出去露营。

lines.en: : I know. And I {i}do{/i} love her. I just...
lines.zh: : 我知道。我{i}确实{/i}爱她。我只是……

lines.en: : I feel like she isn’t really {i}herself{/i} at times. And it’s like talking to a completely different person. {i}That’s{/i} when my feelings start to waver.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她有时候根本不是{i}她自己{/i}。就像在跟一个完全不同的人说话。{i}那种时候{/i}，我的感情就开始动摇了。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: A...different person? Or {i}a different person?{/i}
lines.zh: : 一个……不同的人？还是{i}一个不同的人{/i}？

lines.en: : {i}A different person.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一个不同的人。{/i}

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk17
: You don’t...
lines.zh: : 你不会……你该不会觉得她正在经历我们经历过的事吧？断片……看见东西……

lines.en: : You don’t think she might be going through what {i}we{/i} did, do you? The blackouts...{i}seeing{/i} things...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我的意思是，我{i}确实{/i}有个想法。只是我好像没法跟她谈这个，因为她总在做些该死的疯狂事。

lines.en: : I have no idea...And by that I mean I {i}do{/i} have an idea. I just can’t seem to talk to her about it because she’s always doing something fucking crazy.
lines.zh: : 嗯。可如果{i}这{/i}就是你说的「她不像她自己」，你不觉得这反而让「{i}给{/i}她你能给的全部的爱」变得比以往更重要吗？

lines.en: : Right. But if {i}that’s{/i} what you mean when you say she isn’t acting like herself, don’t you think it makes it more important than ever {i}to{/i} give her all of the love you possibly can?
lines.zh: : 因为你太清楚那些时刻有多可怕了，Akira。你知道迷失自我有多无力。也就是说，Ami 大概也在害怕。

lines.en: : Because you know exactly how scary those moments can be, Akira. You know how powerless it feels to lose yourself. Which means Ami’s probably scared too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她可一点都没表现出来。所以才这么难……给她需要的那份关爱。

lines.en: : Well...she sure doesn’t act like it. And that’s why it’s been so hard to really...give her the affection she needs.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她可一点都没表现出来。所以才这么难……给她需要的那份关爱。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk18

: Like, I obviously {i}do{/i} love her. And I want to love {i}all{/i} of her. But there’s something inside of me that’s almost holding me back from doing that. Like she’s...threatening my entire existence or something.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我{i}当然{/i}爱她。我想爱她的{i}全部{/i}。可我心里有某种东西，几乎在阻止我那么做。就好像她在……威胁我整个人的存在似的。

lines.en: : Would you like {i}me{/i} to talk to her then? As someone apparently safe from the potential bloodshed, as you put it?
lines.zh: : 那要{i}我{/i}去跟她谈谈吗？作为一个按你说法、显然能幸免于潜在流血事件的人？

lines.en: : Maybe she’s just scared because she thinks she’s alone? That no one else has ever experienced what she’s going through and {i}that’s{/i} what makes it hard to talk.
lines.zh: : 也许她只是害怕，因为她觉得自己是孤单一人？觉得从来没有人经历过她正在经历的事，{i}所以{/i}才难以开口。

lines.en: : I’ve put you through enough trouble as-is, Sara. I can’t keep relying on you to sub in whenever I can’t break through to my own daughter.
lines.zh: : 我已经够麻烦你了，Sara。我不能每次突破不了自己女儿，就一直依赖你来顶班。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk19

: Well, this is normally where I’d tell you to marry me and that this problem would be solved if I was just her mother, but I think you’ve made it very clear that Niki is closer to that than I will ever be.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这时候我通常会说「娶了我吧」，只要我当她妈妈，这问题就解决了——不过我想你已经说得很清楚了，Niki 比我更接近那个位置，而且永远都会是。

lines.en: : Which is not something I should be jealous about given that she is better than me in basically every single category, but I am jealous nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 这本来不是我该嫉妒的事，毕竟她基本上每一项都比我强，可我还是嫉妒。

lines.en: : Would you talk to her, please?
lines.zh: : 你会去跟她谈谈吗，拜托？

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk20
: Niki or Ami? Which one are we talking about now? Because I need to prepare if I’m going to meet an idol. I don’t want her to think I’m boring.
lines.zh: : Niki 还是 Ami？我们现在说的是哪个？因为要见偶像的话，我得准备准备。我不想让她觉得我很无聊。

lines.en: : Ami. Fix her and I’ll let you borrow Niki for an entire week.
lines.zh: : Ami。把她治好，我就把 Niki 借给你整整一周。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk21
: That’s enough time to watch all of Supernatural together...
lines.zh: : 那时间够我们一起把《Supernatural》全看完了……

lines.en: : If that’s what you want to use her for, fine. Just help me out, please. I don’t know what else to do and it really does seem like you’re the only girl Ami-
lines.zh: : 你要拿她干这个也行。只要帮我一把，拜托。我不知道还能怎么办，而且真的只有你这么一个女孩子能让 Ami——

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk22
: Akira, you really don’t need to thank me. I’d do this even if you didn’t ask.
lines.zh: : Akira，你真的不用谢我。就算你不求我，我也会这么做。

lines.en: : I know what it’s like not having parents to rely on. Which is why I’ll always be there for {i}any{/i} confused kid who needs me. Not just Ami.
lines.zh: : 我知道没有父母可以依靠是什么滋味。所以{i}任何{/i}迷茫的孩子需要我，我都会在。不只是 Ami。

lines.en: : She’s just the one who happens to need the most help right now.
lines.zh: : 她只是眼下最需要帮助的那个。

lines.en: : Have her drop by the bar soon. Tell her you need her to pick something up. Or just that I want to talk to her if you don’t think she’ll find that weird.
lines.zh: : 让她最近来趟酒吧。跟她说你要她去拿点东西。或者直接说我想跟她谈谈——只要你觉得她不会觉得奇怪。

lines.en: : I don’t think she’d find it weird at all. Unless her attitude toward you is just one more long-con and that she secretly despises you more than anyone.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她一点都不会觉得奇怪。除非她对你的态度只是又一场长线骗局，而她其实暗地里比任何人都恨你。

lines.en: : That would make me very sad. But I’m willing to try either way.
lines.zh: : 那会让我很伤心。不过不管怎样我都愿意试试。

lines.en: : Then you’re already stronger than me. I don’t think “trying” is really in my blood.
lines.zh: : 那你已经比我坚强了。我觉得「尝试」这两个字本来就不在我的血里。

lines.en: : Yes, look at me and admire my effort. It’s all I really have going for me, after all.
lines.zh: : 对，看着我，钦佩我的努力吧。毕竟那是我唯一拿得出手的东西了。

lines.en: : You say that, but I think you’d make just as good of an idol as Niki if you were ever given the shot.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，可我觉得要是给你机会，你会跟 Niki 一样成为一个好偶像。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk23
: M...Me?! No way. There’s not a chance. No way in Hell.
lines.zh: : 我……我？！不可能。没戏。绝对不可能。

lines.en: : I don’t know. You really pulled off that idol costume a while back. And I think a lot of people would say you look even younger than Niki.
lines.zh: : 我可说不准。你前阵子穿那身偶像装还挺像样的。而且我觉得很多人会说你看起来比 Niki 还年轻。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk24
: N...Now you’re just {i}trying{/i} to embarrass me.
lines.zh: : 你……你现在{i}只是{/i}想让我难为情。

lines.en: : It’s working too. Your face is beet red all of a sudden. You really like being complimented, huh?
lines.zh: : 而且还成功了。你的脸一下子红透了。你真的很喜欢被人夸，是吧？

lines.en: : Nuh-uh...
lines.zh: : 没有啦……

lines.en: scene black
: A few more...wouldn’t hurt, though...
lines.zh: : 再多夸……几句……也不碍事……

lines.en: else:
scene saranoonwalk25
: A...different person, huh?
lines.zh: : 一个……不同的人，嗯？

lines.en: : Yes. But why do you look so reflective and melancholic after repeating that?
lines.zh: : 对。可你重复这句话之后，为什么看起来这么若有所思又忧郁？

lines.en: : It’s nothing...I just felt that way a lot when I was her age too. And if she’s going through anything even half as bad as what I did, it’s no wonder she feels that way.
lines.zh: : 没什么……只是我在她那个年纪也常有这种感觉。如果她正在经历的事有我当年一半糟糕，那她会这样也就不足为奇了。

lines.en: : You mean, like with...how you were abused and all of that?
lines.zh: : 你是说，比如……你被虐待之类的事？

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk26
: Sure...let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……就这么说吧。

lines.en: : I mean, let’s not {i}go{/i} with anything. Just tell me what you mean without making it look like you’re keeping some sort of secret. Because this is exactly what Ami does.
lines.zh: : 我是说，什么也别「{i}就这么说{/i}」。直说你是什么意思，别搞得像在藏着什么秘密似的。因为 Ami 就是这样的。

lines.en: : Then maybe Ami and I have more in common than I thought?
lines.zh: : 那也许 Ami 和我的共同点比我想的还多？

lines.en: : Sara-
lines.zh: : Sara——

lines.en: : Have her drop by the bar soon. Tell her you need her to pick something up. Or just that I want to talk to her if you don’t think she’ll find that weird.
lines.zh: : 让她最近来趟酒吧。跟她说你要她去拿点东西。或者直接说我想跟她谈谈——只要你觉得她不会觉得奇怪。

lines.en: : I don’t think she’ll find it weird at all. In fact, if anything, I think she’d be happy to see you. I just struggle to understand what you think you two have in common and why you can magically cure it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她一点都不会觉得奇怪。事实上，我觉得她见到你会很高兴。我只是搞不懂，你觉得你们俩有什么共同点，又凭什么能神奇地治好她。

lines.en: : Now, who said anything about a cure? Sometimes, all a girl needs is someone who understands her. And I’m not saying I {i}will.{/i} Just that I might.
lines.zh: : 谁说要治好了？有时候，一个女孩需要的只是一个懂她的人。我不是说我{i}一定{/i}懂，只是也许。

lines.en: : And in the worst case scenario where I don’t, maybe I can just do her hair again. She seemed to really like that last time.
lines.zh: : 而万一我不懂，最坏的情况，我也许可以再给她梳一次头。她上次好像挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...she has a lot less to work with now than she did back then.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……她现在可比那时候没什么可梳的了。

lines.en: : Then maybe I’ll let her do mine. We’ll make a whole night out of it. And who knows? Maybe she’ll be completely “repaired” the next time you see her?
lines.zh: : 那就让她梳我的。我们干脆把它搞成一整个夜晚。谁知道呢？也许你下次见到她时，她就彻底「修好」了？

lines.en: : Or maybe she’ll be begging me to marry you and kick Niki out of the house again.
lines.zh: : 或者她会求我娶你，再把 Niki 赶出家门。

lines.en: scene saranoonwalk27
: Either way, I win.
lines.zh: : 不管哪种，我都赢。

lines.en: : Now, please excuse me as I eat all of the pasta I am not allowed to have while my daughter is in the house.
lines.zh: : 那么，请原谅我要把这些在家里有女儿时不许我吃的意面全吃光了。

lines.en: : Your problems are so much smaller than mine.
lines.zh: : 你的烦恼比我小多了。

lines.en: : Oh, Akira...
lines.zh: : 哦，Akira……

lines.en: scene black
: If only you knew...
lines.zh: : 要是你知道就好了……

lines.en: Sara and I spend the rest of the afternoon gorging on Italian food while talking about parenting.
lines.zh: Sara 和我用剩下的半个下午大吃意大利菜，一边聊着育儿。

lines.en: I hate it.
lines.zh: 我讨厌这个。

lines.en: But I like {i}her...{/i}
lines.zh: 但我喜欢{i}她……{/i}

lines.en: So that makes it mostly okay.
lines.zh: 所以总的来说还算可以。

lines.en: And when I drop her off at the bar and the see the light reflecting off of the same silver necklace she always keeps draped around her neck, there’s a thought that makes me like her even more.
lines.zh: 而当我把她送回酒吧、看到光从那条她总是挂在脖子上的银项链上反射出来时，有个念头让我更喜欢她了。

lines.en: But it’s a depressing one, for it paints a picture I’m not sure I’ll ever see.
lines.zh: 可那是个让人沮丧的念头，因为它画出的那幅画面，我不确定自己这辈子能不能看到。

lines.en: It involves the sun, the window in my bedroom, and her facing the mirror as she puts it on in the morning.
lines.zh: 它牵涉到阳光、我卧室的窗户，还有她早上对着镜子把项链戴上的样子。

lines.en: I wonder what life would be like if she were the one I grew up with?
lines.zh: 我在想，如果和我一起长大的人是她，人生会是什么样？
